title: Five-setup levelling run, rise-and-fall reduction: CONSISTENCY with the book's height-of-instrument elevations (NAVEDTRA 14069, Fig. 14-14; case C4)

source.citation: US Navy, Engineering Aid, NAVEDTRA 14069, chapter 14, Fig. 14-14

verification: D-20 condition 2: this case verifies NUMERICAL CONSISTENCY, not the rise-and-fall method. The source reduces this field book by the height-of-instrument method; its elevations are the expected values here. Exact rational arithmetic (outside the repository, 2026-11-26) shows that the rise-and-fall method gives identical elevations on a field book of backsight and foresight pairs: rises 1.688, 0, 0, 0.151, 5.288 and falls 0, 2.484, 1.349, 0, 0 (not printed by the source, so not asserted here; the unit and property tests cover them). Tolerance 0.0005 ft is half the last printed digit.
